purpose: Allow at most one pre-HOLDOUT sample-size increase from non-directional nuisance information without changing the SESOI or inspecting which confirmatory arm is better.
allowed_timing: after TRAIN/DEV pipeline feasibility but before any HOLDOUT or REPLICATION access and before any confirmatory directional effect is revealed
allowed_inputs: declared failure indicator without arm identity plus predeclared failure-family code
pre_split construction eligibility indicator and reason code
forbidden_inputs: which arm wins a discordant pair
reviewer or analyst narrative describing directional treatment performance

immutable_parameters.primary_estimand: paired absolute correctness difference at base_scenario_id

decision_rule.updated_required_n: max(accepted_R2_required_n, minimum N passing the frozen R2 Monte-Carlo lower-bound and Type-I/joint-success rules under conservative blinded nuisance bounds)
decision_rule.if_updated_nuisance_bound_unavailable: use frozen conservative planning value and accepted_R2_required_n floor; never substitute a favorable guess
decision_rule.pre_split_inventory_loss: may increase raw collection target but never decreases required eligible base_scenario_id N
decision_rule.runtime_failures: remain scored incorrect; never converted to attrition to lower denominator
